title: Mission worktrees must share the primary target cache
goal: A harness worktree keeps a private target directory, so every mission compiles the whole dependency graph cold (candle, wasmtime, onnx) and a single acceptance command can block a worker for over half an hour. Link the shared target after workflow start, running scripts/link-shared-target.sh in the new worktree, so a mission reuses the primary build cache and only rebuilds its own crate.
